selection_rationale: cand_2026_b2 targets a high-impact, tractable gap (NL→formal-spec semantic correctness) with clear, measurable primary outcome, modest estimated model-call cost, direct alignment to unresolved question Q2, and reviewer-identified repairs that are concrete and addressable before preregistration.
unresolved_uncertainties: Q2: How reliably can natural-language intents be translated into formal specifications with semantic correctness sufficient for sound automated verification?
Completeness risk of the verifier test-harness (can the harness fully represent intent semantics without biasing outcomes)
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Publish precise, auditable verifier test-harness: code, test-cases per intent, coverage criteria, and how pass/fail is determined.
Produce expert-authored ground-truth formal specifications with documented annotation protocol and inter-annotator agreement metrics.
Predefine ambiguity-handling rules for underspecified intents (e.g., reject/ask-clarification/annotator adjudication) and incorporate them into evaluation criteria.
Run and report a sample-size/power analysis for expected effect sizes and allocate model-call budget to meet it; document seeds and retry policy.

Specify exact verifier tools and versions, include contingency plans if the verifier cannot express certain intent semantics, and publish transformation code between generated specs and verifier inputs.
